problems.formal_statement:
theorem OAI.PiExponent.exists_rational_parameters (ν : ℝ) (hν : 2 < ν) :
    ∃ θ A B C : ℚ,
      0 < (θ : ℝ) ∧ (θ : ℝ) < A ∧ (A : ℝ) < B ∧ (B : ℝ) < 1 ∧
      ν * ((A : ℝ) - θ) > 1 - θ ∧
      1 < (C : ℝ) ∧ (B : ℝ) < 1 / C ∧
      (B : ℝ) < C * θ ∧ (C : ℝ) * θ < 1 := by sorry
problems.theorem_title: Rational parameter selection for exponents above two
problems.natural_language_statement: For every real ν > 2, there exist rational numbers θ, A, B, and C such that, when viewed as real numbers, 0 < θ < A < B < 1, ν(A − θ) > 1 − θ, 1 < C, B < 1/C, B < Cθ, and Cθ < 1.
